authoritative_sources.paper: Shen et al. 2019 PLOS Comput Biol 15(1):e1006633 doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1006633 (Methods: Mental imagery experiment)

bdpy_label_semantics: condition-local ordinal 1-26 (vmap empty); Label==category_index; Label k <-> Img{k:04d}; NOT a global stimulus identity

family_fixation_assignment.basis: paper contract (25=10nat+15art+1fix) + KamitaniLab official reconstruction code ordering + paper Fig 3; NOT numeric-label equality, NOT any neural result

matched_perception.note: released bdpy does not expose per-imagery-target exact image filenames; matched-perception reliability is computed at the FAMILY-CONDITION level (conservative matched control), not a 1:1 target subset

terminology: DIR imagery = specific memorized IMAGE exemplars (NOT GOD semantic object categories)
corrections_vs_c3x: report within-family reliability R_I_natural (10) and R_I_artificial (15) to avoid natural-vs-artificial family-separation confound
acquire perceptionArtificialImage as the artificial matched control (C3X had only perceptionNaturalImageTest)
